name: tampere360
description: Tampere360 — Tampereen seudun reaaliaikainen tilannekuva. Serverless, tapahtumavetoinen AWS-arkkitehtuuri (CDK v2, TypeScript).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tampere360/event-contracts && npm run build -w @tampere360/source-adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @tampere360/observability && npm run build -w @tampere360/infra && npm run typecheck:apps && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck:apps: for app in ingest-fmi ingest-tampere-traffic ingest-police ingest-events ingest-nysse ingest-rescue normalize situation-processor api; do echo "--- $app"; (cd apps/$app && tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; done
